question: Does replacing isolated H-alpha rates with finite spherical intercell transfer improve the observed residual after a complete atmosphere re-solve?
baseline: The converged PR12/13 eight-cell atmosphere at mass loss 1.051271096376025e13 g/s, checkpoint SHA-256 5968dc1aa29319561908eac0147c37c05c0972c30180a479bdeacba11a71ddf2.
physical_change: Replace the three H-alpha upward, downward and old OTS channels together with resolved spherical CRD transfer.
Include the resolved-minus-actual-background photon correction in all continuum receivers and the matching redistribution heat.
Separate the line contribution from the background-geometry correction in the diagnostics.
Re-solve all population coordinates, upper temperatures and the induced wind/density response at fixed mass loss.
Retain the same prescribed lower two cells, other atomic data, stellar boundary, composition and physical domain.

initial_halpha_quadrature.note: Approximately +/-350 km/s, not the observational +/-120 km/s interval. Wider-band and quadrature checks must be recorded separately.

required: Final H-alpha blend exactly one; the blend is a numerical continuation coordinate, not a fitted physical parameter.
All physical, wind, prescribed-mask and reference-domain guards pass.
The retained inverse is an accelerator, not an asserted current Jacobian or convergence certificate.
No unconverged state is promoted to a final observed-spectrum result.

gpu_acceleration.scope: The unchanged physical operator may run in float64 on CUDA as a numerical accelerator.
gpu_acceleration.independent_cpu_gate: Before final acceptance, evaluate the complete CPU residual and physical state at exactly the exported GPU theta; do not adjust theta during this crosscheck.
gpu_acceleration.required: All original physical/conservation and source/input/dependency checks must pass; report T/ne/bound/velocity numerical differences. A GPU solver receipt alone does not satisfy this gate.

observation_comparison.operator: Identical PR13 spherical observer, PHX sampling and native shared-reference contrast operator.
observation_comparison.noise: Same fixed GP covariance hyperparameters for baseline and candidate; no new posterior inference.
observation_comparison.primary_pixels: Original stride 2, offset 0; complementary offset 1 is a separate sensitivity comparison.
observation_comparison.nuisance: Report the unchanged baseline RV/amplitude and the separately profiled shared RV/amplitude.
observation_comparison.score: Delta Q = Q_baseline - Q_candidate, with positive values indicating lower conditional squared residual.
observation_comparison.report: Global and night/order Q, blue/core/red data-minus-prediction residuals in ppm, and the full residual plot.
observation_comparison.limits: Conditional Q improvement does not establish posterior evidence, correct observational covariance or a unique physical explanation.
